title: SkillShift-Bench: Benchmarking Skill Learning under Environment Evolution for Web Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.33528v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skill learning enables web agents to reuse prior experience for long-horizon interactive tasks. However, learned skills are typically evaluated in closed environments, overlooking the fact that real-world web deployment involves continuous shifts in invocation context, perceptual grounding, and execution feasibility. To this end, we introduce SkillShift-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating skill learning with controlled open-environment shifts. SkillShift-Bench simulates Contextual Shift, Perceptual Shift, and Execution Shift across three self-hosted web systems, and evaluates agents with diagnostics covering task success, interaction cost, skill use, and skill failure. Comprehensive experiments reveal systematic robustness degradation under controlled shifts, characterized by lower success rates, higher interaction costs, and more frequent skill failures, with Execution Shift exerting the strongest pressure. translated_title: SkillShift-Bench：面向Web智能体的环境演化下技能学习基准测试
translated_abstract: 技能学习使Web智能体能够复用先前经验来完成长程交互任务。然而，已学到的技能通常在封闭环境中进行评估，忽略了现实世界的Web部署中调用上下文、感知基础和执行可行性会持续变化这一事实。为此，我们提出了SkillShift-Bench，这是首个用于评估受控开放环境变化下技能学习的基准。SkillShift-Bench在三个自托管的Web系统上模拟了上下文变化、感知变化和执行变化，并通过涵盖任务成功、交互成本、技能使用和技能失败的诊断指标来评估智能体。全面的实验揭示了在受控变化下智能体鲁棒性的系统性下降，表现为更低的成功率、更高的交互成本和更频繁的技能失败，其中执行变化带来的压力最强。我们进一步制定了……（原文摘要似乎被截断）
tldr: 提出首个评估Web智能体技能学习在环境演化下鲁棒性的基准SkillShift-Bench，通过模拟上下文、感知和执行三类受控变化，系统揭示了技能复用能力的显著退化。
